'''Nature Demon Mordlim''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is one of the eight Demon Lords of Ishgria who rules over the land of [[Rakshult]].
__TOC__

==Debut Appearance==


==In the storyline==
When the first expedition to Ishgria led by an official of the Elgaia Federation was enacted before the main storyline, [http://bravefrontierglobal.wikia.com/wiki/Heins one of the criminals] exploring Rakshult encountered Mordlim, who demanded he state the purpose of the expedition. Upon his reply, the two engaged in a fierce battle; Mordlim, victorious, slew him.

==Personality==
Mordlim looks down upon humans, acting as if she is superior to them, and even goes so far as to attack any in her domain.

==Abilities==
As the demoness of nature, Mordlim uses various plant and nature-based attacks; she has a strong defensive fighting style incorporating an elemental barrier technique and the ability to grant herself angel Idol buffs. herself Angel Idol Buff. Like her fellow Demon Lords, Mordlim can use Empty Seal.
